title: Meatball Walked Into a Rainforest Holding a Sandwich

beats.say: Meatball walked into a rainforest holding a sandwich.
A cassowary smelled it. They run thirty miles an hour.
Each foot hides a four inch dagger claw.
It stands as tall as a grown man.
Would Meatball survive? Only if he drops the sandwich. He didn't.
